description: A PostHog organization domain: an email domain the organization claims (verified with a DNS TXT record), used for SSO enforcement, SAML and just-in-time provisioning.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

OrganizationId.description: ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization that claims the domain.

Domain.description: The email domain, e.g. example.com. Changing it replaces the resource (and requires verifying the new domain).

JitProvisioningEnabled.description: Whether users with an email address on this (verified) domain can join the organization automatically when they log in with SSO.

SsoEnforcement.description: SSO provider that users on this domain must log in with, e.g. google-oauth2, github, gitlab or saml. Empty means no enforcement.

IsVerified.description: Whether the domain has been verified.

VerifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the domain was verified.

VerificationChallenge.description: Value of the DNS TXT record (on _posthog-challenge.<domain>) that proves ownership of the domain.

ScimBaseUrl.description: SCIM base URL for this domain, when SCIM is configured.
